articles.summary: Portillo's famous cake collides with milk’s favorite cookie for three new creations – the OREO Shake, OREO Cake and OREO Cake Shake CHICAGO, Oct. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Portillo’s fans know the brand’s famous chocolate cake and cake shakes are simply out of this world.
